children: The long-hypothesized merger between SpaceX and Tesla, Elon Musk's two flagship public companies, may be coming closer to reality. Musk says that both companies have formed special board committees to discuss a potential merger, adding that he serves on neither committee and that no deal is guaranteed. "But I do think there is a lot of merit in combining the companies," Musk added. He says any merger would be put to shareholders for a vote. Tesla shares are up 1.5% and SpaceX gains 5% in after-hours trading. (elias.schisgall@wsj.com)
